parameter.label: TOP : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT DISTINCT TOP.GRUPO AS VALUE, TOP.GRUPO AS LABEL FROM TGFTOP TOP WHERE GOLSINAL= -1 ORDER BY 1

chart.expression:
SELECT CASE WHEN PRO.CODPROD IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(PRO.CODPROD), 1, 1) = '3' THEN TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(PRO.CODPROD), 1, 1) || '1' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(PRO.CODPROD), 3) ) ELSE PRO.CODPROD END AS CODPROD_TRATADO,
TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'Mon/YYYY') AS PERIODO, TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'YYYYMM') AS ORDEM,
SUM( ( (ITE.VLRTOT) - (CASE WHEN :DESC = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRDESC ELSE 0 END) - (CASE WHEN :REP = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :ST = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRSUBST ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :IPI = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END) ) * CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * VCAB.INDITENS ) AS VALOR
FROM TGFCAB CAB JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD JOIN TGFTOP TPO ON CAB.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER JOIN VGFCAB VCAB ON VCAB.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA
WHERE (CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' OR :STATUSNOTA = 'N') AND ITE.USOPROD <> 'D' AND TPO.GOLSINAL = -1 AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND TPO.GRUPO IN :TOP AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND (:PRODUTO IS NULL OR PRO.CODPROD = :PRODUTO)
GROUP BY CASE WHEN PRO.CODPROD IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(PRO.CODPROD), 1, 1) = '3' THEN TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(PRO.CODPROD), 1, 1) || '1' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(PRO.CODPROD), 3) ) ELSE PRO.CODPROD END, TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'Mon/YYYY'), TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'YYYYMM')
ORDER BY ORDEM

SELECT VEN.APELIDO, SUM ( (( (ITE.VLRTOT) - (CASE WHEN :DESC = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRDESC ELSE 0 END) - (CASE WHEN :REP = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :ST = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRSUBST ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :IPI = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END) ) * CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) * VCAB.INDITENS ) AS VALOR,
TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'Mon/YYYY') AS PER, TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'YYYYMM') AS ORDEM, ven.codvend
FROM TGFCAB CAB , TGFPAR PAR , TGFITE ITE , TGFPRO PRO , TGFTOP TPO , TGFVEN VEN , VGFCAB VCAB WHERE (CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' OR :STATUSNOTA = 'N') AND ITE.USOPROD <> 'D' AND TPO.GOLSINAL = -1 AND VCAB.NUNOTA= CAB.NUNOTA
AND ((TPO.GRUPO IN :TOP)) AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND VEN.CODVEND= CAB.CODVEND AND ((PRO.CODPROD= :PRODUTO) OR (:PRODUTO IS NULL)) AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER and TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'Mon/YYYY')=:PER GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'Mon/YYYY'), TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'YYYYMM') , VEN.APELIDO, ven.codvend ORDER BY 2 DESC

grid.expression:
SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, PAR.NOMEPARC, CAB.DTNEG, SUM ( (( (ITE.VLRTOT) - (CASE WHEN :DESC = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRDESC ELSE 0 END) - (CASE WHEN :REP = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :ST = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRSUBST ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :IPI = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END) ) * CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) * VCAB.INDITENS ) AS VALOR
FROM TGFCAB CAB , TGFPAR PAR , TGFITE ITE , TGFPRO PRO , TGFTOP TPO , TGFVEN VEN , VGFCAB VCAB WHERE (CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' OR :STATUSNOTA = 'N') AND ITE.USOPROD <> 'D' AND TPO.GOLSINAL = -1 AND VCAB.NUNOTA= CAB.NUNOTA AND ((TPO.GRUPO IN :TOP)) AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND ((PRO.CODPROD= :PRODUTO) OR (:PRODUTO IS NULL)) AND VEN.CODVEND= CAB.CODVEND AND APELIDO =:VENDEDOR AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER and TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'Mon/YYYY')=:PER and ven.codvend= :CODVEND GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, PAR.NOMEPARC, CAB.DTNEG
